contexts.text: They who are in falsity and evil are in continual terror lest they be killed. Illustrated.
A mere hiss would drive them into terror... They thought in their terror that all Hell was rising...
From (these penalties) they contract terrors and horrors for such things.
Under the veil they feel such anxiety and terror...

The fear of you, and the terror of you () = the dominion of the internal man; fear regards evils; and terror, falsities... For, when the internal man dominates, the man is in fear on account of evils, and in terror on account of falsities... But it is (only) the external man that is terrified... (Continued. See Fear.)
(Evil Spirits) are sometimes seized with terror on their first approach (to such a man).
A terror of great darkness () = that the darkness was terrible... ( = that He shuddered at so great a vastation. AC 1839:3.)
When Spirits merely think of such truth (without good), there arises something of terror. Explained.
A terror of God was upon the cities... () = that falsities and evils could not come near; for a terror of God = protection. AC 4555:2, Explained.
Not that the Lord terrifies them...
This naked arm... according to its position excites terror; in this position, incredible terror... Even those who have not been timorous... are thrown into extreme terror by it.
The lightnings, etc. = the terrors caused by the Divine truth with those who are not in good.
They enlarged themselves, and thus terrified (those other Spirits).
For it is allowed the Spirits (of the peritoneum), when infested by others... to strike them with terror SE 991.
Under Tremble, see this reference. AC 8312.
From terror of the penalties.

Terror took hold of them () = that they dared not attempt anything... For with those who are in terror, the blood grows cold, and rushes into the veins, and the circulation ceases; hence the nerves become flaccid, and the forces full, so that they dare not do anything.
They who are in evil are in terror at the presence of the Divine...
I will send My terror before thee () = the terror of those who are in evils of falsity on account of truths of good. Explained.
When they are in Hell, they are in terror and consternation on account of the truths from good in which the Angels are...
Terror is predicated of those in evils; dread of those in falsities.
A great earthquake = ... terror, Explained.
They saw nothing but terrors before their eyes.
The rest became terrified () = from fear when they saw the destruction of others. ( = they were disturbed in mind and turned away. AE 677.)
The leaves of these trees strike terror (there) when they are shaken by a strong wind; but not the leaves of the others.
On seeing (that devil) I was terrified.
On the terror of those who have led a perverted life.
That the Truth terrifies.

In the other life, people can be struck with so much terror that they as it were melt away... even those who had lived almost devoid of terror. This terror comes forth from that Truth in which there is not goodness, or mercy; then such a terror penetrates the marrows, and as it were breaks the bones; for Truth condemns to the lowest Hell...

That there are those who strike terrors. - There are Spirits who trust in their own forces, who are sometimes permitted to induce terrors, incredible ones. They are permitted to represent a naked arm. (Explained.)

These were such as had formerly slain whole armies... for they rushed into the chambers of the brain, and injected such terror that one slew another... At this day however [they can do this] only a little (in certain cases of suicide). Explained.
How certain evil ones are reduced into terror, on account of evils they had perpetrated (here).
The crowd was dispersed, and so the terror (caused by those who correspond to cats) ceased.
The terror caused by those who are called the ast wind. Described.
The consequent damnation is signified by they shall be clothed with terrors... ().
Thine heart shall meditate terror... () = remembrance of the state of the Church...

Terror, and consternation, in the Word, = a state of the lower mind disturbed and changed by an imminent or visible danger to the life; but this is one thing with the good, and another with the evil. Explained, Illustrated.
These passages (show) that terror, and dread, in the Word, mean various disturbances of the lower mind from such things as cause amazement, and which are conjoined also with joy.

Again, terror = terror on account of evils and falsities from Hell; for these terrify the spiritual man, because they are the opposites of goods and truths, which the spiritual man love, and the loss of which he fears. Illustrated.
Terror on every side () = spiritual death.
Terror () = destruction.
